name: tickets
label: Tickets
purpose: The process, for whoever wants one: a change is a ticket the AI drafts and you approve (on the board, or by telling it), its blast radius in front of you, a verdict on every turn, verified → Passed → promoted. With Coding on, Passed is the promote and a red line that blocks stops it. Off for a project that is not being worked this way.
questionsNote: The four places a promote needs, typed in - never guessed. Everything else has a default: the repository's own main branch; promote by git the moment a ticket is passed; the live environment is called prod; nothing runs after the checkout. A project that needs different (e.g. observed deploys via GitHub Actions, uat before prod, after-commands) sets the keys branch, deployMode, deployTrigger, deployAfter, envName, versionUrls in .cockpit/plugins/tickets.json - still read.
